issues.title: 57% of Kenyans fear arrest, abductions if they join protests - survey
issues.title_en: 57% of Kenyans fear arrest, abductions if they join protests - survey
issues.summary: The survey also identifies hired goons as a major source of protest-related violence, with more than half of respondents blaming individuals allegedly paid to infiltrate demonstrations and trigger chaos.
